comment: If you are a guy, stay away- you can do the same level of work as a female and get half to a full grade letter lower.

She breaks down spanish and is helpful when you don't understand.  never felt embarrassed when i got a question wrong.  her tests are easy, along with her quizzes.  many vocab quizzes but they are easy. she makes the test easy.  take her, she's nice

Talley is fair and straightforward. We had a lot of busy work but she restructured the class to cut some of it out, now it is much more reasonable. Most homework consists of reading articles or listening to podcasts and the class is mostly discussion with a few presentations and compositions, which are not hard to get an A on.

She is very nice and will help you if you come to her office hours. Her teaching style is pretty clear and straight forward. The only thing that is really annoying is the strict attendance policy. Oh and turn your phone on silent cause she'll freak if it goes off in class. Study and do homework (there's a lot of it) and you'll be fine.
Talley is a very fair professor. She is very nice and will help you out whenever she can. She gives a lot of busy work and speaks spanish throughout the whole class.
